rec.body: Follow README as an adopter, including first write, snapshot, check, hook installation, and doctor. Capture friction before a hard launch.
rec.disposition: On 2026-10-02, scripted maintainer first-use trials used an anonymous HTTPS clone of df18859da4e9784242f82e895ad1657846727c6c. Cargo installed the Rust CLI; a one-file Python copy ran with Python 3.12. Each in a separate scratch Git repo completed init, Unicode add, snapshot, check, next, adopter-hook installation, doctor reporting an active gate, and a hook-mediated commit. Rust also answered stdio MCP calls. Fresh clone needed sync for seven published log entries; doctor --fix enabled hooks but refused init over the tracked projection. This followed README steps in a controlled script, not an uncoached adopter trial.
